metadata.title: Finite-Time Singularities of the Kähler--Ricci Flow on a $\mathbb{CP}^m$-Bundle over a Product of Kähler--Einstein Manifolds
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the Kähler--Ricci flow on $\mathbb{CP}^m$-bundles over a product of Kähler--Einstein manifolds, starting from an initial metric with Calabi symmetry. We prove that every finite-time singularity arising along the flow must be of Type~I.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在 Kähler–Einstein 乘积上 CPm 丛的 Calabi 对称初始度量下，证明 Kähler–Ricci 流有限时奇点均为 I 型。
analysis.breakthrough: 控制一类高维丛空间的奇点形成类型。
analysis.limitations: 依赖对称初值与特定丛结构，不是一般流的 I 型定理。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
analysis.priorityReason: 几何流奇点模型直接相关。
